value.rationale: The natural fault sequence of complete bipartite graphs has stagewise homotopy already classified, but those independent stages conceal persistent survival and death. This theorem gives the entire integral barcode and primitive images for arbitrary bipartition sizes, a structurally motivated completion of the family that distinguishes maps not reconstructible from Betti numbers.
